summary: ICICI Bank Limited furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that its Board of Directors will meet on Saturday, October 17, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and six months ending September 30, 2026. The filing also notes the trading window for designated persons and directors will remain closed from October 1 to October 19, 2026 under SEBI insider-trading rules. This is a routine earnings-calendar and blackout notice, with no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics. Watch only for the scheduled results release; no risk-arb angle.
